{{Quote|The human's starship, it flies as if by magic. If Poggle crosses him, the human might use his magic against us.|Anonymous [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] guard|<ref name="NEGVV" />}}
The '''''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop''' was a personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] designed by the [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] possessed such a vessel that was gifted to him by [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|His particular vessel]] was heavily modified, propelled by a unique [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sail]] using ancient [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] technology. He used the vessel to enter and leave [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] undetected.

==Characteristics==
The seed-shaped vessel bore a resemblance to the smaller [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian starfighter]], though the sloop had room inside for two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], a bunk, and cargo space. Though unarmed, the solar sloop featured eighty-four miniature [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]] fitted to the forward prongs, which acted both as steering aids and emergency grapple weapons.

==History==
Count Dooku received an interstellar sloop as a gift from his [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] colleagues prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. To the Geonosian sloop, Dooku added a unique and ancient [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sail]] acquired in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. Fitted to his vessel, the solar sail propelled the sailer through mysterious means; regular solar sailers used sails that unfurled to moon-like diameters, catching [[Tachyon/Legends|tachyon]] streams and [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] lasers. An [[FA-4 pilot droid/Legends|FA-4 pilot droid]] flew the sailer for Dooku, who was often found in the rear hold, perusing the onboard [[data book]] library.

[[File:Sailer_NEGVV.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A ''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop modified with a solar sail]]
When war [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|erupted]] on Geonosis, Dooku fled to [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|his secret hangar]] in the desert, intent on fleeing the massive battle between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. Dooku was waylaid by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and barely escaped into the safety of his sailer. The solar sailer left Geonosis far behind, heading for a dark rendezvous with Dooku's Master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on Coruscant.

Dooku owned at least one decoy sloop, and also provided multiple members of his [[Dark Acolyte]] cadre with similar ships as well. His [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] all used ''Punworcca 116'' sloops during various missions.

During Dooku's escape to [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], part of the [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|Skirmish at Vanqor]], his sloop was shot down and crashed. [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] salvaged the ship and claimed it as their own. Later, Dooku got another one for his mission to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], where he killed [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] for her disobedience.

An example of this vessel was identified as a distinctive "Geonosian fantail" by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker when they discovered it on [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]].

==Behind the scenes==
Inspirations for the solar sailer came from abandoned concepts for the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Queen's Royal Starship]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|Episode I]]. When the solar sail idea was removed from the chrome aesthetics of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] design sensibilities and placed into the harsh insectoid warrens of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the ship itself also developed insect-like characteristics. Some designs closely resembled a water beetle in shape and texture, while others were more elegant, butterfly-like incarnations.

At first, Dooku's ship was envisioned like a limousine, with its pilot in an enclosed compartment separated from its important passenger. Later, during filming, it was decided that a shot of Count Dooku seated next to the pilot droid was needed, so the ship was redesigned with the cockpit bubble more connected to the ship's interior space.<ref name="DB-Geonosian solar sailer">{{DB|starship|solarsailer|Geonosian solar sailer}}</ref>
